_comment: GENERATED by pipeline/analysis/chart_data.py. Do not edit by hand.
note: Employees plus trade-licence holders for 2024. Summed over employment_status because the 'total' row is not available on this cut, and the two components do not overlap.
sql:
SELECT 2024 as year, 'labour' as pathway, SUM(value) as value
            FROM 's2.parquet'
            WHERE pathway = 'labour'
              AND year = 2024
              AND sex = 'all'
              AND age_bracket = 'all'
              AND education = 'all'
              AND employment_status IN ('employed', 'self_employed')
